description: Add comprehensive type hints to all functions in data_processor.py. Add 'from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Any' at the top. For each function: (1) calculate_average(numbers) should be annotated as List[float] -> Optional[float], (2) format_user_data(user_id, username, email, age, is_active) should have int, str, str, int, bool parameters returning Dict[str, Any], (3) filter_by_threshold(items, threshold) should be List[float], float -> List[float], (4) merge_configs(base_config, override_config) should be Dict[str, Any], Optional[Dict[str, Any]] -> Dict[str, Any], (5) process_records(records, max_results) should be List[Any], Optional[int] -> List[Any]. Save the file after adding all type hints.
